notes.title: Ok Gamers big update
notes.content:
[b] Small bug fixes and other things.. [/b]

Give her a shot!
[list]
[*] Leaving/Joining should now be fixed
[*] End Game should work, not sure.
[*]Voices, and all sounds have been turned down.
[*]Monsters are stronger and more aggressive.
[*] Monsters eyes are darker and hard to see.
[*]Third Person is now back.
[/list]

[u]Achievements are going out today, you can find them on steam and how to get them should be pretty easy.[/u]
Thanks 
- Milkweedgg
